configurePresets.name: windows-mingw-release
configurePresets.description: Qt 6 MinGW x64 Release build. Requires QT_ROOT (Qt kit dir, e.g. .../6.8.0/mingw_64) and SUBREC_FFMPEG_ROOT (shared FFmpeg dir with include/, lib/, bin/) in the environment; MinGW g++ and Ninja must be on PATH. Override locally with CMakeUserPresets.json.
